learn.hook: Who made your clay diya, your wooden stool and your cotton kurta? Skilled hands called artisans!
points: Artisans are skilled people who make things with their hands and simple tools.
A potter shapes clay on a spinning wheel called a chaak to make pots, diyas and matkas.
A weaver makes cloth on a loom. A carpenter makes furniture from wood.
A blacksmith heats iron till it glows and beats it into tools. A basket maker weaves baskets from bamboo or cane.
Artisans often learn their skills from elders in the family, and they take great care over each piece.

example.q: A potter has wet clay. Why does he dry the pot in the sun and then bake it in a hot kiln?
steps: Wet clay is soft, so the pot can lose its shape or break.
Drying in the sun removes water from the clay.
Baking it in a kiln makes the pot hard and strong so it can hold water.
example.answer: Drying and baking make the clay pot hard and strong

learn.reallife: Next time you buy diyas or a matka, remember the potter who made each one by hand.

games.title: Making a clay pot
games.prompt: Put the potter's steps in order
items: Mix clay with water and knead it
Shape it on the spinning wheel
Dry the pot in the sun

quiz.q: Who is an artisan?
options: A skilled person who makes things by hand
A person who only sells cars
A person who drives a bus
quiz.explain: Potters, weavers, carpenters and basket makers are artisans.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the word artisan

quiz.q: What does a weaver use to make cloth?
quiz.explain: A weaver passes threads over and under each other on a loom to make cloth.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the tools of different artisans

quiz.q: Who makes tools from iron by heating and beating it?
quiz.explain: A blacksmith heats iron until it glows and then shapes it with a hammer.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up blacksmith with other artisans

quiz.q: In Hindi, what is the potter's spinning wheel called?
quiz.explain: The potter's wheel is called a chaak. A charkha is a spinning wheel for making thread.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up chaak and charkha

quiz.q: Why does a potter bake clay pots in a kiln?
options: To make them hard and strong
quiz.explain: The great heat of the kiln makes clay hard, so the pot can hold water.
quiz.mistake: Thinks baking makes clay softer

quiz.q: A carpenter mainly works with ___.
quiz.explain: Carpenters make doors, tables and chairs from wood.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the materials of different artisans

quiz.q: Which of these is made by a basket maker?
quiz.explain: Basket makers weave baskets from bamboo, cane or grass.
quiz.mistake: Does not link the artisan to the product

quiz.q: A potter makes 5 diyas every hour. How many diyas will he make in 4 hours?
quiz.explain: 5 diyas each hour for 4 hours is 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 20 diyas.
quiz.mistake: Adds 5 and 4 instead of making 4 groups of 5

teach.ask: Gappu found a lovely clay pot. He asks: who made it, and how?
teach.praise: Chirp! The potter shaped the clay on a wheel and baked it. Amazing!
teach.nudge: What does the potter use to shape the clay?

learn.hook: India has hundreds of crafts! Each region has its own colours, patterns and styles.
points: Madhubani paintings from Bihar are full of bright colours, fish, birds and flowers.
Warli paintings from Maharashtra use simple white shapes like circles, triangles and lines.
Blue pottery comes from Jaipur in Rajasthan. Bandhani, a tie-and-dye cloth, is made in Gujarat and Rajasthan.
Channapatna in Karnataka is famous for colourful wooden toys. Kondapalli in Andhra Pradesh makes wooden toys too.
Pashmina shawls come from Kashmir. Bamboo and cane crafts are famous in Assam and other states of the North-East.

example.q: A painting shows people dancing in a circle, drawn using only white triangles, circles and lines. Which painting style is this likely to be?
steps: The clues are: simple shapes and white colour.
Warli painting uses white shapes like circles, triangles and lines.
So this is most likely a Warli painting.

learn.reallife: Look at the dupattas, toys or pots in your home. Can you find out which state's craft they are?

games.title: Craft facts
items: Warli paintings use simple shapes like circles and triangles.
Warli art shows people and animals with basic shapes.
Channapatna is famous for wooden toys.

Blue pottery is a famous craft of Jaipur.
Jaipur in Rajasthan is famous for blue pottery.

Small parts of the cloth are tied with thread before dyeing, making dotted patterns.

quiz.q: Madhubani painting comes from which state?
quiz.explain: Madhubani painting is a famous art of the Mithila region of Bihar.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up crafts of different states

quiz.q: Which painting style uses simple white shapes like circles and triangles?
quiz.explain: Warli paintings from Maharashtra use simple white shapes on a dark background.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up painting styles

quiz.q: Channapatna in Karnataka is famous for ___.
quiz.explain: Channapatna makes smooth, brightly coloured wooden toys.
quiz.mistake: Does not know this craft

quiz.q: Blue pottery is a famous craft of which city?
quiz.explain: Jaipur in Rajasthan is known for its blue pottery.
quiz.mistake: Guesses a city without knowing

quiz.q: Pashmina shawls come from ___.
quiz.explain: Soft, warm pashmina shawls come from Kashmir.
quiz.mistake: Does not link warm shawls with a cold place

quiz.q: How is bandhani cloth made?
options: By tying small parts of cloth and dyeing it
quiz.explain: Small bits of cloth are tied tightly with thread before dyeing, so those parts stay uncoloured.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the tie-and-dye method

quiz.q: Pattachitra is a painting style from which state?
quiz.explain: Pattachitra paintings on cloth are a famous art of Odisha.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up crafts of different states

quiz.q: Which material is used for many crafts in Assam and the North-East?
quiz.explain: Bamboo grows well in the North-East, so many baskets and crafts are made from bamboo and cane.
quiz.mistake: Does not link crafts with local materials

teach.ask: Gappu saw beautiful paintings and toys at a craft fair. He asks: where do these crafts come from?
teach.praise: Tweet! Every state has its own special craft!
teach.nudge: Can you name a painting style and the state it comes from?

learn.hook: An old bottle, a used box, a torn T-shirt — don't throw them away. Turn them into treasure!
points: Many things we throw away can be used again to make something new and useful.
An empty plastic bottle can become a plant pot or a bird feeder.
Old newspapers can be folded into paper bags.
Old clothes can be cut into strips and woven into a doormat or a rag doll.
Always ask an adult to help with scissors or sharp edges, and wash containers clean before using them.

example.q: Ishaan has an empty plastic bottle, some string and grains. What useful thing can he make?
steps: With an adult's help, small holes can be cut in the side for birds to peck through.
Hang it from a branch with string.

learn.reallife: Make a 'best out of waste' corner at home or school. See how many useful things your class can make!

items.q: Grow a plant in a cut bottle: a plant ___
Hang a bottle with grains for birds
Ask him or her to help with scissors
Weave old cloth strips into a ___

quiz.q: What can you make from an empty plastic bottle?
quiz.explain: A cut plastic bottle can hold soil and a small plant.
quiz.mistake: Does not see waste as a material

quiz.q: Which useful thing can be made from old newspapers?
quiz.explain: Newspapers can be folded and glued into strong paper bags.
quiz.mistake: Does not match waste to a new use

quiz.q: Why should we make useful things from waste?
options: It reduces garbage and saves materials
quiz.explain: Using waste again means less garbage and fewer new things need to be made.
quiz.mistake: Does not see the benefit of reusing

quiz.q: What should you do before cutting a tin or a bottle for a craft?
quiz.explain: Cut edges can be sharp. An adult can cut safely or help you.
quiz.mistake: Does not think about safety

quiz.q: Old clothes can be cut into strips and woven into a ___.
quiz.explain: Cloth strips can be braided or woven into a soft doormat.
quiz.mistake: Does not see old cloth as a material

quiz.q: Why should you wash an old jar before turning it into a pen stand?
options: To remove leftover food and germs
quiz.explain: Leftover food can smell and attract ants and germs.
quiz.mistake: Skips cleaning before reusing

quiz.q: Which of these should NOT be used for a craft at home?
quiz.explain: Broken glass is sharp and can cut your hands.
quiz.mistake: Does not think about which waste is unsafe

quiz.q: Pinki made 3 pen stands from old tins, and Bunty made 4. How many pen stands did they make together?
quiz.explain: 3 + 4 = 7 pen stands.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts or multiplies instead of adding

teach.praise: Chirp! I made a bird feeder from waste — and my friends love it!
teach.nudge: How do I stay safe when cutting a bottle?
